name: Skull Blast (CR 14)
body:
Skull Blast
CR 14

XP 38,400

Type magic; Perception DC 30; Disable Device DC 30

EFFECTS

Trigger proximity (alarm); Reset none

Effect blast of negative energy (20d6 negative energy damage to all living creatures, DC 20 Fort save for half damage, undead creatures are healed 20d6 points of damage); multiple targets (all targets in a 30-ft. burst)
